description: Stock help/status source rows referenced by the C0:33B5 24-bit interface pointer table. ROM pointers, terminators and layout framing are derived from the clean USA ROM.

entries.source: WELCOME TO SECRET OF MANA.
CHOOSE “NEW GAME” TO START FROM THE BEGINNING.
CHOOSE “GAME FILE” TO START FROM WHERE YOU LAST SAVED.
PRESS B-BUTTON TO START.
SAVING OVER AN OLD FILE WILL ERASE THE OLD DATA.
PUSH “ATTACK” BUTTON TO SAVE.  PUSH “ICON” BUTTON TO EXIT.
SELECT A WINDOW WITH THE DIRECTION KEY.
CHANGE THE COLOR GAUGE BY PRESSING A/Y/X DOWN.
PUSH B-BUTTON TO SET.  PUSH SELECT BUTTON TO EXIT.
SELECT A LETTER USING THE CONTROL PAD. PRESS THE “ATTACK”
(OR B BUTTON) TO ENTER. NAMES CAN BE UP TO 6 LETTERS LONG.
PRESS THE START BUTTON TO CONTINUE.
PLACE FOR ACTION TYPE. PUSH “ATTACK” BUTTON TO SET.
KEEP GAUGE UP TO WHICH LEVEL? PUSH “ATTACK” BUTTON TO SET.
CHECK THE WEAPON SKILL/LEVEL DATA HERE.
PUSH “ATTACK” BUTTON TO START. CHOOSE A WEAPON WITH
THE CONTROL PAD. PUSH “ATTACK” TO SEE DATA.
CHECK THE MAGIC SKILL/LEVEL DATA HERE.
PUSH “ATTACK” BUTTON TO START. CHOOSE AN ELEVENTAL WITH
THE CONTROL PAD. PUSH “ATTACK” TO SEE DATA.
TO CHANGE THE BUTTON ASSIGNMENT, KEEP THE BUTTON DOWN,AND
PUSH RIGHT/LEFT ON THE CONTROL PAD. RELEASE TO SET.
PUSH L OR R-BUTTON TO CHANGE THE CONTROLLER TYPE.
PUSH START TO SET.  PUSH SELECT TO EXIT.
